set.scroll.hint: Trackpad: ku jiid laba farood si aad u wareegto, hay Shift oo jiid si aad u guurto muuqaalka, ku fur-xir si aad u weynaysid. Tuubada mouse-ka: tuubadu waa weyneysaa. "Si toos ah u ogaan" wuxuu u qaataa jiidista dhinac ama mid yar-yar sida trackpad.
set.touch2.hint: Laba farood waxay sidoo kale ku fur-xirtaa si ay u weyneyso; saddex farood waxay sameeyaan kan kale. Hay hal farood meel madhan si sugan, kadibna jiid, si aad hal farood ugu wareegto. Markaad sawirto, muuqaal kor ka yaal farajkaaga ayaa tusaya barta ay ku xidhmayso.

Demin: had iyo jeer dhexda aragtida. Hay Shift markaad wareegayso si aad u guurto, sii deyso si aad mar kale u wareegto. Xawaaruhu wuxuu khuseeyaa mouse-ka, trackpad-ka, taabashada iyo furayaasha fallaadhaha.

app.prep.verdict.fix.other: {n} shay oo la hagaajiyo ka hor daabacaadda.

app.prep.verdict.look.other: Diyaar u ah daabacaadda, iyadoo {n} shay marka hore la eego.

app.prep.nothing: Waxba toos looma hagaajin karin: eeg waxa la sameeyo dhibaato kasta.
app.prep.bed.none: Saxanka daabacaha lama dooran, sidaas darteed cabbirka lama hubinayo (Dejinta › ModelCraft).
app.prep.todo.empty: Muuji qaybaha aad rabto inaad daabacto, ama dooro, kadibna mar kale hubi.
app.prep.why.open: Daabacaha wuxuu u baahan yahay qaab xidhan si uu u ogaado waxa gudaha ku jira. Haddii qori jirto, slicer-ku wuu male-gaa ama diidaa.
app.prep.todo.open: Hagaaji wixii la hagaajin karo wuxuu xidhaa godadka simman. Haddii kale, dhis wejiga maqan.
app.prep.why.nonmanifold: Meel ay saddex wejiyo ka wadaagaan hal geesood, slicer-ku ma kala soo saari karo gudaha iyo dibadda.
app.prep.todo.nonmanifold: Hagaaji wixii la hagaajin karo wuxuu tirtiraa wejiyada gudaha qaabka. Haddii kale, tirtir wejiga dheeraadka ah.
app.prep.why.flipped: Wejiga jihada gudaha u jeeda wuxuu slicer-ka ku horeeyaa in dhinacaas uu madhan yahay.
app.prep.todo.flipped: Hagaaji wixii la hagaajin karo wuxuu wejigaas u rogaa jihada saxda ah.
app.prep.why.inverted: Qayb dibadda-gudaha ah waxay u akhrisata meel madhan: waxay u daabacmaysaa wax aan lahayn, ama waxay ku gooysaa waxa ku wareegsan.
app.prep.todo.inverted: Hagaaji wixii la hagaajin karo wuxuu u rogaa jihada saxda ah.
app.prep.why.selfintersect: Meel qayb iskay u kaxaysata, slicer-ku ma garan karo dhinacyada jirdilka ah.
app.prep.todo.selfintersect: Dooro qaybta, isticmaal Edit › More › Intersect with model, kadibna tirtir waxa gudaha ku jira.
app.prep.why.overlap: Qaybaha isku dhacaya waxay u daabacmaan hal qayb, taas oo badanaa tan la rabo.
app.prep.todo.overlap: Si aad u hubiso, isku dhaji iyagoo adeegsanaya Solids › Union.
app.prep.why.touch: Qaybaha kaliya isku taabta ayaa laga yaabaa in la isku daro ama kala go'o.
app.prep.todo.touch: Isku dhaji iyagoo adeegsanaya Solids › Union, ama u dhaqaaq kala fogee.
app.prep.why.tiny: Moodeel lagu sawiray unug qalad ah ayaa aad uga yar daabacmaa.
app.prep.todo.tiny: Hubi unugga status bar-ka, kadibna moodeelka kor u weynee.
app.prep.why.bed: Ma gelayso saxanka daabacaha ee lagu doortay Dejinta.
app.prep.todo.bed: Yar garee, rog, ama u gooy qaybo.
app.prep.why.nobase: Daabacaadu wuxuu u baahan yahay wejig simman oo saxanka ku fadhiya si uu u dhisan yahay.
app.prep.todo.nobase: Rog moodeelka si wejig simman uu hoos ugu jiro, ama ka tag slicer-ku inuu ku daro taageero.
app.prep.why.overhang: Daabacaha wuxuu ka dhisaa lakab-lakab hoosta ilaa sare, lakabka ma laga yaabo inuu hawada ku sii taagnaado.
app.prep.todo.overhang: Rog moodeelka si uu wax yar u leexdo, ama ka tag slicer-ku inuu ku daro taageero.
app.prep.why.degenerate: Wejiyada aan bal-ballac lahayn ma beddelaan daabacaadda.
app.prep.todo.degenerate: Waxba ma jiro oo la sameeyo.
app.prep.why.unchecked: Moodeel aad u weyn ayaa qayb ahaan kaliya loo hubiyaa in qaybaha iskood ula gudbaan.
app.guide.title: Moodeelkaaga ugu horreeya
app.guide.face.body: Riix {key} ama dooro qalabka, guji hal geesood dhulka, kadibna geesta ka soo hor jeeda. Ama guji hal geesood, ku qor {eg} oo riix {enter}.
app.guide.solid.h: Afar-geeska kor ugu jiid sanduuq ah
app.guide.solid.body: Riix {key} ama dooro qalabka, guji afar-geeska, u dhaqaaq kor oo guji. Ama ku qor dherer sida {eg} oo riix {enter}.
app.guide.group.body: Dooro sanduuqa oo dhan, kadibna riix {key} si uu koox ugu noqdo. Koox ayaa wejiyadeeda wada haysa, sidaas darteed wey wada guuraan, waxna aad ku sawirto agtiisa ma ku xidhmaan.
app.guide.print.body: Guji Hadda hubi (ama Dhoofin › Hubi daabacaadda 3D). Markii ay tidhi Diyaar u ah daabacaadda, soo dejiso fayl 3MF ama STL oo u ah slicer-ka daabacahaaga.
app.guide.done.body: Xiga, ku sawir wejiga sanduuqa si aad faahfaahin ugu darto, ku dhig wax Maktabadda bilowga, ama riix F1 si aad caawimaad u hesho.

app.import.site.group: Dhammaan kooxda ayay ku jiraan: kala fur si aad uga sawirto si toos ah.

m3d.tool.click_to_select_drag_left_to: Guji si aad u doorato. Jiid bidix ka midig daaqad ahaan, midig ka bidix xulasho is-goyn ahaan. Laba jeer guji koox si aad u furto.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_line: Guji dhamaadka xariiqda, ama ku qor dherer. Esc waa joojinaysaa.
m3d.tool.click_the_opposite_corner_or_ty: Guji geeska ka soo horjeeda, ama ku qor ballac, joog (tusaale: 4m,3m).
m3d.tool.click_the_first_corner_on_the: Guji geeska koowaad — dhulka ama wejiga kasta.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_red: Rektangil ku xidhan diyaaradda cas (toosan, siman cas). Isla furaha mar kale si aad u furto.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_green: Rektangil ku xidhan diyaaradda cagaar (toosan, siman cagaar). Isla furaha mar kale si aad u furto.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_blue: Rektangil ku xidhan diyaaradda buluug (heer). Isla furaha mar kale si aad u furto.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_radius_or: Guji si aad u dejiso gacanka, ama ku qor. Ku qor 12s si aad u hesho 12 dhinac.
m3d.tool.click_the_start_of_the_arc: Guji bilowga qaansada — dhulka ama wejiga kasta.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_arc: Guji dhamaadka qaansada, ama ku qor dherer xarriiqda u dhexaysa.
m3d.tool.move_to_bulge_the_arc_click: U guur si aad qaansada u kor u kacdo, guji, ama ku qor kor-u-kac. Ku qor 12s si aad u hesho 12 qayb.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_arc: Guji bartilmaameedka qaansada — dhulka ama wejiga kasta.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_starts_or: Guji meesha qaansadu ka bilowdo, ama ku qor gacanka.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_ends_or: Guji meesha qaansadu ku dhammaato, ama ku qor xagasha digriiska.
m3d.tool.click_where_this_point_goes_or: Guji meesha barta tan tagayso, ama ku qor <dx,dy,dz>. Esc waa soo celinaysaa.
m3d.tool.click_a_square_to_move_that: Guji laba-jibbaar si aad barta qallooca u guurto. Esc waa dhammeynaysaa.
m3d.tool.click_the_next_point_enter_or: Guji barta xigta. Enter ama laba jeer guji waa dhammeynaysaa; guji barta koowaad si aad u xidho; Backspace waxay qaadaa barta ugu dambaysa.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_along: Guji wejiga si aad ugu raacdo waddada la doortay.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_then: Guji wejiga si aad u raacdo, kadibna geesha waddada — ama marka hore waddada dooro.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_offset_its: Guji wejig si aad u kala fogeyso geeskiisa, ama marka hore geesaha dooro. Laba jeer guji wejig si aad u soo celiso masaafadii u dambaysay.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_group_or_component: Guji wejiga, kooxda ama qaybta si aad u midaysid. Ctrl: wejiyada xidhan ee midabkaas · Shift: dhammaan wejiyada midabkaas · Alt: qaad midab.
m3d.tool.picked_up_the_default_color: Midabkii caadiga ahaa ayaa la qaatay.
m3d.tool.move_to_push_or_pull_click: U guur si aad riixdo ama jiidto, guji si aad u dhammeysid, ama ku qor masaafo.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_push_or: Guji wejig si aad u riixdo ama u jiidto. Laba jeer guji wejig si aad u soo celiso masaafadii u dambaysay.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_move_from: Guji barta laga guurayo (marka hore dooro, ama shayga cursorka hoostiisa ayaa guurayo). Ctrl waa koobiyeynaysaa.
m3d.tool.stopped_touching: — waxay joogsatay meesha ay ku taabanayso {name}
m3d.tool.touch_loose: jiomatari xor ah oo kooxdan ku jira
m3d.tool.copied_type_3x_for_more_copies: Waa la koobiyeeyay. Ku qor 3x si aad koobiyo badan oo isku xigta u hesho, ama /3 si aad masaafada u qaybiso.
m3d.tool.click_the_centre_of_rotation_on: Guji bartilmaameedka wareegga (ku wareeg wejig si aad ugu wareegto diyaaradeeda; furayaasha falka ayaa dhidibka doortaa).
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_angle_or: Guji si aad u dejiso xagasha, ama ku qor digriiska.
m3d.tool.rotate_copy_on: Koobiyeynta: asalku wuu joogaa. Ctrl wuu wareegayaa halkii.
m3d.tool.rotated_copy_type_3x: Waa la koobiyeeyay. Ku qor 3x si aad koobiyo badan oo ku wareegsan bartilmaameedka u hesho, ama /3 si aad xagasha u qaybiso.
m3d.tool.move_to_turn_click_to_finish: U guur si aad wareegto, guji si aad u dhammeysid, ama ku qor digriiska. X, Y ama Z ayaa dhidibka doortaa.
m3d.tool.move_to_resize_click_to_finish: U guur si aad cabbirka u beddesho, guji si aad u dhammeysid; ama ku qor isu-dhufasho (2), ama mid dhidib kasta (2,1,0.5 cas, cagaar, buluug).
m3d.tool.drag_or_click_a_grip_on: Jiid ama guji gacanta sanduuqa: geesaha si siman ayay u weynaadaan, xarriiqyada ama dhinacyada ayay fidaan (Ctrl: bartilmaameedka ku wareegsan). Ama guji barta joogta ah.
m3d.tool.move_away_from_the_centre_to: Ka fogaad bartilmaameedka si aad u weynaysid, ugu soo dhow si aad u yarayso; guji si aad u dhammeysid, ama ku qor isu-dhufasho.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_a_group_a: Guji geesha, kooxda, hagaha ama cabbirka si aad u tirtirto, ama jiid dhowr. Wejiyada waxay la socdaan geeskooda.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_and_click: Ka guuri geesha oo guji si aad u dhigto khadka hagaha isbarbar socda, ama ku qor kala-fogaanta.
m3d.tool.click_to_measure_and_drop_a: Guji si aad u cabbirto oo aad u dhigto bar hage, ama ku qor masaafo.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_to_start_a: Guji geesha si aad u bilowdo khad hage oo isbarbar la socda, ama barta laga cabbirayo.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_protrac: Guji bartilmaameedka xagle-qiyaaska — haddii uu wejig ku jiro, wejigaas ku jiro.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_for_0_arrow: Guji barta 0° (furayaasha falka: istaag xagle-qiyaaska siman cas, cagaar ama buluug).
m3d.tool.move_to_the_angle_15_steps: U guur xagasha (kor u kaca 15° ayaa ku dhegan) oo guji, ama ku qor digriiska.
m3d.tool.move_to_place_the_dimension_lin: U guur si aad u dhigto xarriiqda cabbirka oo guji, ama ku qor kala-fogaanteeda.
m3d.tool.drag_to_orbit_middle_drag_orbit: Jiid si aad u wareegto; hay Shift si aad u guurto muuqaalka. Jiidista dhexe ayaa wareegta qalab kasta.
m3d.tool.drag_to_pan_shift_middle_drag: Jiid si aad muuqaalka u guurto. Shift + jiidista dhexe ayaa guurta qalab kasta.
m3d.tool.drag_up_and_down_to_zoom: Jiid sare iyo hoos si aad u weynaysid. Curinka ayaa weynaysa qalab kasta.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_component_goes_: Guji meesha qaybtu tagayso (bilowgeeda ayaa halkaas degta).
m3d.tool.click_where_the_pasted_copy_goe: Guji meesha koobiga la dhajiyay tagayso (geeska hoose ayaa halkaas degta). Esc waa joojinaysaa.
m3d.tool.type_a_length_above_zero: Ku qor dherer ka weyn eber.
m3d.tool.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: Qalloocan lama wax ka beddeli karo mar dambe (waa la fidiyay ama la kala jaray); mar kale sawir.
m3d.tool.click_two_points_or_more_for: Guji laba bar ama ka badan qallooca.
m3d.tool.that_edge_is_part_of_the: Geeskaas qayb ka mid ah wejiga: guji geesha waddada.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_inside_the_open_2: Guji wejig (gudaha kooxda furan), ama marka hore geesaha dooro.
m3d.tool.push_pull_works_on_a_face: Riix/jiid wejig ayaa shaqeysa. Guji wejig.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_move_first_: Marka hore wax dooro si aad u guurto, ama guji shayga.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_rotate_firs: Marka hore wax dooro si aad u wareegto, ama guji shayga.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_scale_first: Marka hore wax dooro si aad u miisaanto, ama guji shayga.
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_2: Ku qor isu-dhufasho ka weyn 0 (2), ama saddex: cas, cagaar, buluug (2,1,0.5).
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_such: Ku qor isu-dhufasho ka weyn 0, sida 2 ama 0.5.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_first_to: Marka hore ka guuri geesha si aad u muujiso dhinaca.
m3d.tool.move_the_pointer_first_to_show: Marka hore cursorka guuri si aad u muujiso dhinaca uu cabbirku tagayo.
m3d.tool.circle_center: Guji bartilmaameedka — dhulka ama wejiga kasta. Ku qor {eg}s si aad dhinacyada u beddesho (hadda {n}).
m3d.tool.curve_edit_failed: Qallooca lama wax ka beddeli karin: {error}
m3d.tool.curve_done: Qallooc laga marayo {n} bar. Dooro oo guji Wax ka beddel barta macluumaadka shayga si aad u beddesho.
m3d.tool.curve_done_closed: Qallooc xidhan oo laga marayo {n} bar. Dooro oo guji Wax ka beddel barta macluumaadka shayga si aad u beddesho.

m3d.tool.follow_done.one: Waxaa lagu raacay {n} geesha: {faces} wejig oo cusub.
m3d.tool.follow_done.other: Waxaa lagu raacay {n} geesood: {faces} wejig oo cusub.

m3d.tool.follow_ring.one: Waxaa lagu raacay {n} geesha: {faces} wejig oo cusub, oo wareeg xidhan ah.
m3d.tool.follow_ring.other: Waxaa lagu raacay {n} geesood: {faces} wejig oo cusub, oo wareeg xidhan ah.

m3d.tool.stopped_at: Wuu joogsaday meesha uu taabanayo, {d} ku dhow. Collide (hoose midig) demi si aad u gudubto.
m3d.tool.move_where: Guji meesha uu tagayo, ama ku qor masaafo. Ctrl wuxuu sameeyaa koobiyo.
m3d.tool.move_where_copy: Guji meesha uu tagayo, ama ku qor masaafo. Ctrl wuu guurayaa halkii.
m3d.tool.stopped_after: Wuu joogsaday meesha uu taabanayo, {d} kadib. Collide (hoose midig) demi si aad u gudubto.
m3d.tool.dim_start: Guji geesha si aad uga cabbirto, ama guji geesha (qaansada ama goobada: gacankeeda ama dhexroodkeeda).
m3d.tool.dim_start_resize: Guji geeska ama geesha si aad u cabbirto, ama ku qor dherer si aad u beddesho wixii aad hadda cabbirtay.

m3d.model.a_face_would_shrink_to_nothing: wejig ayaa ilaa eber yaraanaya ama dhinaca gudaha u rogaya
m3d.model.a_face_would_bend_out_of: wejig ayaa ka baxaya diyaaraddiisa; cabbir geesha ku sii, ama cas, cagaar ama buluug
m3d.model.only_arcs_circles_and_polygons: Qaansooyinka, goobooyinka iyo poligonnada oo keliya ayaa gacan leh.
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_that: Qalloocan wejig ayaa xidha oo ka baxa diyaaraddiisa (la riixay ama la jiiday): gacankiisa hadda ma beddeli karo.
m3d.model.type_a_radius_above_zero: Ku qor gacan ka weyn eber.
